provenance.method: The original hymn-book tune attribution identifies the Cambridge melody. Every upper-voice notehead of its pinned original vector score matches the unmodified original MIDI with zero symbolic edits; printed rhythms are manually reviewed. Both recordings independently pass complete and per-stanza MIDI/print checks using STFT and constant-Q features. All eight onset paths agree within 0.5 seconds and retain original cost, key-margin, span and repeat-phase gates. The failed independent harmonic-arrangement comparison is retained as diagnostic. All five original stanzas are shown in order, with adjacent lyric previews. These are score-based reading previews, not claimed vocal recognition or exact sung onsets. Initial reading is shown from zero.

performanceOrder.text: 那登锡安的人，脚踪何等佳美， 宣告上主救恩喜讯，传扬平安佳音。
performanceOrder.label: 第1段

performanceOrder.text: 何等悦耳声音，何等美妙喜讯， 锡安看哪！你救赎主永远凯旋为君。
performanceOrder.label: 第2段

performanceOrder.text: 历代先知君王，寻找却未寻见， 我耳得闻喜乐佳音，无比快慰难言。
performanceOrder.label: 第3段

performanceOrder.text: 历代先知君王，至终未见所望， 我眼得见天上真光，蒙主恩福无量。
performanceOrder.label: 第4段

performanceOrder.text: 上主伸出圣臂，能力广庇全地， 今让天下万国万民，朝拜救主真神。
performanceOrder.label: 第5段
